replies.author: @JohnDemoted
replies.text: There is actually a top and bottom to the solar system, which gives planet Earth, a defacto top and bottom.  If you start with a cloud of randomly moving dust particles subject to the force of gravity and then apply Newtonian mechanics to the cloud, you end up with a net angular momentum and a bowl shaped set of objects orbiting around a massive central object.  The bowl shaped solar system has a bottom at the bottom of the bowl and a top at the bowl rim.  Take your right hand and curve your fingers in the direction of the Earth's rotation and your thumb will be on the top.
